verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: Azure Advisor Security Recommendations Evidence
evidence_commands: $j = (az advisor recommendation list --output json | Out-String) | ConvertFrom-Json; $items = @(); if ($null -ne $j) { if ($j -isnot [array] -and $j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'value') { $items = @($j.value | Where-Object { $_ }) } else { $items = @($j | Where-Object { $_ }) } }; [pscustomobject]@{ count = $items.Count; recommendations = @($items | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ category = $_.category; impact = $_.impact; problem = $_.shortDescription.problem } }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
